course_name_original: Programming of metal cutting on CNC machines
course_name_en: Programming of metal cutting on CNC machines
prerequisites: General knowledge about metal cutting, milling technology and milling tools.
Knowledge of modelling in CAD software is advantage.

learning_outcomes.text: Introduce to the students the advanced method of CNC machines programming.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to use of CAM software, automated programming of CNC machines. Basic work in 3D milling.
Model import issues and solutions. Model adjustments. Definition of cutting tool and cutting conditions.
Boundaries and patterns and their utilization for finishing.
Workplanes. Setup of workplanes and their use for machining. Milling in 4D
NC code and its adjustments, NC code validation.
CAM and its connection in PLM.
3D milling partprogram setup. Semifinishing and finishing.
Model import and adjustments. Definiton of cutting tools and cutting conditions enrty.
Semestral project - NC program and it simulation.
Semestral project - Machining on CNC machine.

assessment_methods.method: Semestral project - NC program and it simulation
Semestral project - Machining on CNC machine

bibliography: Journal of Computational Design and Engineering - http://www.jcde.org
